confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate, not checked against live menus, tariffs or booking sites; no web search was used for city prices. Restaurant and cafe anchors are moderately grounded; beer, cocktail and wine are least certain because alcohol taxes and bar markups vary widely, and July 2026 accommodation rates may move with tax, currency and season. Cocktail and wine_glass are set at about two times the beer anchor because direct bar-price knowledge is weak. The FX observation comes from a web search summary of rba.gov.au data, not a direct page read.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional basis: South Asian tourist-capital price levels. Colombo is placed above budget South Asian capitals such as Kathmandu for hotels and alcohol, reflecting Sri Lanka's high alcohol taxes and tourist-hotel pricing. No named listing set was used as a direct comparison.
